verdict.rationale: All documented flows (purchase intent, card enrollment, credential retrieval) are scoped to a single instruction, merchant, and amount at a time; there is no mention of batch/bulk transaction processing, multi-item purchase intents, or bulk invoice/payment-link creation across many items. The axis is plausible for a commerce/payments platform (e.g., bulk invoicing), but no evidence supports it — missing for 10: any documented batch/bulk API endpoint, multi-item purchase intent support, or bulk invoice/payment-link management capability.
